read.thesis: Booking Q3 beat on room nights (+7%) and gross bookings (+10%), but Q4 guides room nights +1–3% and adjusted EBITDA about flat as travel moderated late in the quarter and investment steps up.

triggers.label: Q4 room nights guided 1–3%
triggers.quote: We currently expect fourth quarter room nights to increase between 1% and 3%, reflecting the toughest prior-year comparison

triggers.label: Late-quarter demand moderation
triggers.quote: we saw some moderation towards the end of the period

triggers.label: Q4 EBITDA about flat YoY
triggers.quote: we expect adjusted EBITDA to be about flat year-over-year, or up about 2% on a constant currency basis

triggers.label: Constant currency ADR up ~3%
triggers.quote: constant currency ADRs up approximately 3% year-over-year

triggers.label: Flight tickets +19% YoY
triggers.quote: flight tickets increased 19% year-over-year, a strong acceleration from the second quarter
